entries.text: in August 2005 [t], Vin Diesel and Chuck Norris went shark fishing 845 miles east of Bermuda and 1,139 miles west of the Azores Islands. After finishing 10 kegs of Milwaukee’s Best and 2 barbecued tiger sharks, [t] asked Vin Diesel to pull his finger. At the exact moment that Vin Diesel pulled [t]’s finger Chuck Norris roundhouse kicked [t] in the stomach “for fun”. The resulting flatulence referred to by most as “Hurricane Katrina” has cost over $1.13 billion so far and almost destroyed New Orleans. To help alleviate his conscience, Chuck will provide free “Roundhouse Kick” seminars to the hurricane victims. As for [t], he will simply pity the fools
